editorial:
Imagine coming back to your old hometown only to find out a mob killed your brother. That is exactly what Hud Dixon has to deal with here. He is not just looking for a hug and a drink, though; he wants a little bit of revenge. To get it, he puts together a crew of experts, which is where the title comes from. You get a great mix of tough guys and sneaky characters who all have their own reasons for helping out. The whole vibe feels gritty and mean, but it also has a bit of a dark sense of humor that keeps things from getting too heavy.

You will love how the tension builds up toward the big shootout. The acting is solid, and the way the plot twists keeps you guessing about who is actually on whose side. Some parts move a bit slow in the middle, but the payoff is totally worth it. If you are into old school gunfights, you should definitely check this out. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but honestly, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: Everything comes down to a big showdown where the truth about the murder finally comes out. Hud and his team take on the bad guys in a messy gunfight. You find out that the people in charge were lying about why the brother was killed. After the dust settles and the villains are dead, Hud gets his revenge. He walks away from the town, leaving the corrupt system in ruins behind him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic spaghetti westerns and revenge stories.
